acceptance: A subject at four blocks returns ActionRedesign; at three it does not
A second count at four returns ActionToOperator
A journey through a real resume keeps the count
A seat cannot write the count
fix: Hold one block count per subject in the host record. A seat cannot write it. It survives resume. Add ActionRedesign and ActionToOperator to convergence. Decide returns ActionRedesign past three blocks. A second count past three returns ActionToOperator. Reuse the breaker data where it fits.
summary: The operator rule says a subject blocked more than three times goes to redesign, never to round four. Main does not hold that count. go/internal/convergence/convergence.go:54-62 has no redesign action. Decision.Redesign at line 137 is a list of text lines. The ceilings in go/internal/core/blocker_breaker.go count fingerprints, not one subject across rounds, rebuilds, cycles and resumes. Repeated fix rounds waste cycles.
title: Convergence redesign rung: one host block count per subject, and Decide returns ActionRedesign past three blocks
